question: In the orthogonal test of phenol removal by the alkali-fused gasification slag, what is the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g?
expect: (91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.57% (matches E1 of factor A in Table 3) (Table 2)
rendered:
According to Table 2 in the document, the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g are:

- Run 1: Level 1 of factor A (0.25 g), Level 1 of factor B (30 min), Level 1 of factor C (30 °C), Level 1 of factor D (1), Level 1 of factor E (0 mM)
- Run 2: Level 1 of factor A (0.25 g), Level 2 of factor B (60 min), Level 2 of factor C (40 °C), Level 2 of factor D (3), Level 2 of factor E (5 mM)
- Run 3: Level 1 of factor A (0.25 g), Level 3 of factor B (90 min), Level 3 of factor C (55 °C), Level 3 of factor D (5), Level 3 of factor E (10 mM)
- Run 4: Level 1 of factor A (0.25 g), Level 4 of factor B (120 min), Level 4 of factor C (70 °C), Level 4 of factor D (7), Level 4 of factor E (15 mM)

The phenol removal rates for these four runs are 91.95%, 95.01%, 88.94%, and 82.36%, respectively.

To calculate the mean phenol removal rate, add the removal rates together and divide by 4:

(91.95 + 95.01 + 88.94 + 82.36) / 4 = 89.09

So, the mean phenol removal rate of the four runs with an activated material addition of 0.25 g is 89.09%.
